headline: Anchor WR at 4, hero RB at 17, then hammer the WR value pocket
summary: Every 2026 source agrees on the shape of pick 4: at least one of Gibbs and Bijan is gone, Chase is usually gone, and Puka Nacua is the modal pick. In a 10-team full-PPR room only 20 RBs and 20 WRs start, so the waiver wire is deep and your edge comes from nailing the first two picks and concentrating upside on the bench, not from safe mid-round veterans.
approach: Anchor WR + Hero RB, flexible. Take the best of Gibbs / Bijan / Chase / Nacua at 4. At 17 take a bell-cow RB from the Achane, Chase Brown, Cook, Kenneth Walker, Hampton, Henry group if one is there; if that whole tier is gone, do not reach: pivot to Bowers / McBride or London / Collins and take RBs at 24 and 37. Then hammer WR in rounds 3-6, take one TE from the Loveland / Warren tier or a round 7-8 TE, and draft QB in the Daniels / Maye / Burrow window at 57-64 only if one falls, otherwise wait for Stafford / Kyler / Baker at 97-124. Draft Sharks' 10-team optimizer prefers full Zero RB from this slot (Nacua, London, Collins, Flowers), while PFF and Fantasy Life say RB is the hardest position to wait on in 2026, so anchoring one back is the compromise most sources land on.

pick4.text: Decision rule at 4: Gibbs, then Bijan, then Chase, then Nacua, then Smith-Njigba, with Jonathan Taylor as the RB alternative. Do not take McCaffrey here in full PPR: Yahoo calls him the worst round-1 pick of 2026 (age 30, 400-plus touches, degraded 49ers weapons). Nacua is conditional: the Rams open Thursday, September 10, so before a weekend draft you will know whether his psoas injury cleared and whether the league acted on his review. If he is cleared and playing, take him. If he is out or suspended, take Chase, Bijan or Gibbs if one fell, otherwise Smith-Njigba, with Taylor as the back-first option.

qbte: QB: late-round QB is still the consensus in one-QB leagues. Only 10 QBs start, so the replacement level (Nix, Dart, Stafford, Kyler) sits close to the QB5-8 tier. Josh Allen is the clear QB1 at ADP 26-35 but Mike Clay questions the round-3 opportunity cost; Jayden Daniels goes three rounds later and could out-score him. The cheap way to buy a QB edge in a 10-teamer is Daniels / Maye / Burrow at 57-64, never Allen at 24. TE: Bowers (ADP 21) and McBride (22.5) are the elite tier; ESPN says round 1-2 is too early for a TE in 10-team leagues but warns neither lasts to round 3. Loveland (41) and Warren (52.5) are tier 2; Kraft, LaPorta and Fannin at 74-81 are the 10-team sweet spot; Kittle at 98 carries Achilles risk. Take an elite TE at 17 only if the RB anchor tier is gone.
rules: At 4, take Nacua only if he is cleared for the Thursday opener and not suspended; otherwise Gibbs, Bijan or Chase if one falls, else Smith-Njigba or Taylor. Never McCaffrey in full PPR.

Anchor one bell-cow RB at 17 from whoever is left of Achane, Chase Brown, Cook, Kenneth Walker, Hampton or Henry. Achane and Henry are usually gone by 17 on ESPN; the chip shows each man's chance of being there. Round-2 backs have hit 77 percent since 2016 against 57 percent for round-2 receivers.

If two of Walker, Hampton, Chase Brown, Cook or Henry are on the board at 17 and 24, going RB-RB is the stronger branch (round-3 backs hit 68 percent, receivers 64 percent). If the tier is gone at 17, do not reach: pivot to Bowers, McBride, London or Collins and take backs at 24 and 37.
Hammer WR in rounds 3-6. That is the value pocket: Nabers, A.J. Brown, Flowers, Thomas Jr., Metcalf, Egbuka, McMillan.
Pay for an elite TE only as a pivot, never as the plan. Loveland in round 4 or Kraft / LaPorta / Fannin in rounds 7-8 is the 10-team sweet spot.

Take a QB when the Daniels, Maye, Burrow, Hurts tier is down to its last name, which on ESPN usually happens around picks 57-64; if it empties early, wait for Stafford, Kyler or Baker at 97-124. Do not pay the Allen tax at 24.
Fade the 2026 landmines at ADP: McCaffrey, Jeanty, Love, Kyren Williams, Etienne, Judkins, Skattebo, Tate, Davante Adams.
Buy this week's news: MarShawn Lloyd (Jacobs on the exempt list), Allgeier (Love's ankle), Corum (Kyren's drive split).
Bench equals upside only. In a 10-teamer the waiver wire replaces safe veterans, so spend picks 104-137 on rookies and handcuffs with a path to volume.
Kicker and defense in the last two rounds, and mock from picks 2, 7 and 12 before draft night so you know the turns.
reddit: Reddit's 2026 consensus build (via Fantasy Squawk's roundup of r/fantasyfootball drafters) is robust RB: two backs in the first three rounds, WRs in rounds 4-7, QB punted to round 8 or later. That is more RB-heavy than the PPR expert plans for this slot, which open WR at 4.
Jeremiyah Love: crowd ADP has him RB13 while expert consensus is RB16. The community is buying the No. 3 overall pick's talent; most experts except Mike Clay see an ADP trap in Arizona.
Ashton Jeanty: the crowd keeps him around pick 20 while Yahoo calls him the worst round-2 pick.
Bowers vs McBride: the crowd flipped to Bowers on the Cousins upgrade; FantasySP and ESPN's Matt Bowen still prefer McBride's record 169-target volume.
Josh Allen: crowd ADP pushes him to about 26 in some rooms versus 35 in others, a tax the experts say not to pay in a one-QB league.
Where they agree: Gibbs 1.01, Nacua at 4 in PPR, punt K and DST, and treat 10-team waivers as a resource.

Caveat: reddit.com could not be fetched from this environment, so Reddit sentiment is secondhand and no quotes are reproduced. Search r/fantasyfootball for the Sept 1-4 draft-help threads before your draft.
